description: Single-page architecture and flow reference for the private Next.js trading dashboard. The current MVP is mock-first, client-hydrated, localStorage-backed, and uses server-side API route proxies for provider data that requires secrets.

statusLegend.implemented: Present in source and wired into the dashboard.
statusLegend.manual: Implemented as a user-driven workflow rather than automated ingestion.
statusLegend.cache: Implemented as non-durable browser or process cache.
statusLegend.future: Referenced in docs, comments, or roadmap but not implemented.
statusLegend.mock: Rendered from mock/default data before hydration or when providers are unavailable.

nodes.title: App Router Page
nodes.description: The root page imports mock dashboard data and renders DashboardShell.

nodes.title: DashboardShell
nodes.description: Composes the top bar, market snapshot capture control, Performance Review, Market Overview, Gamma/Fear & Greed, and Trading Context under DailySnapshotProvider.

nodes.title: DailySnapshotProvider
nodes.description: Owns active trading date, active DailyDashboardSnapshot, saved date discovery, date switching, snapshot saves, and transient market/sentiment capture candidates.

nodes.title: Daily Snapshot localStorage
nodes.description: Date-keyed browser persistence for DailyDashboardSnapshot with safe load, normalize, save, and saved-date listing helpers.

nodes.title: Capture Market Snapshot
nodes.description: User action that persists current Market Overview quote context and Fear & Greed read into the active daily snapshot. Hydration alone does not write daily history.

nodes.title: Performance Review
nodes.description: Displays derived account performance, local CSV import previews, trade-ledger metrics, and manual current-position daily state.

nodes.title: Market Overview
nodes.description: Mock-first SPX/watchlist surface that hydrates quotes through /api/market-quotes and embeds the live candle chart component.

nodes.title: SPX Candle Chart
nodes.description: Client-only lightweight-charts candlestick and volume chart with Index/Futures source toggle. It does not write candle data into daily snapshots.

nodes.title: Gamma Context
nodes.description: Manual daily gamma levels and local image-reference workflow stored inside DailyDashboardSnapshot.gamma.

nodes.title: Fear & Greed
nodes.description: Compact CoinMarketCap sentiment instrument. Hydrates through the internal route, writes browser stale cache, and publishes a transient capture candidate.

nodes.title: Trading Context
nodes.description: Four-column workflow for manual Market News, Economic Calendar, Synthesis Notes, and Trading Checklist. Uses the shared daily snapshot provider.

nodes.title: TopBarTelemetry
nodes.description: Header telemetry derived from the mock/live market view model.

nodes.title: GET /api/market-quotes
nodes.description: Server-side quote proxy for FMP and Twelve Data. Keeps provider keys server-only, caches in process memory, and returns controlled partial/unavailable states.

nodes.title: GET /api/market-candles
nodes.description: Server-side Yahoo Finance chart proxy for SPX500 Index and E-Mini futures candle reads. Optional SPY proxy is gated by MARKET_CANDLES_ENABLE_SPY_PROXY.

nodes.title: GET /api/fear-greed
nodes.description: Server-side CoinMarketCap Fear & Greed proxy with in-memory cache and stale fallback.

nodes.title: POST /api/login
nodes.description: Server-side password submission route. Creates an httpOnly signed auth cookie when DASHBOARD_PASSWORD matches.

nodes.title: Auth Proxy Gate
nodes.description: Protects dashboard routes by validating the signed httpOnly cookie and redirecting anonymous users to /login.

nodes.title: Financial Modeling Prep
nodes.description: Quote source for SPX500 proxy/fallback, VIX, EURUSD, BTC primary, and gold fallback.

nodes.title: Twelve Data
nodes.description: Quote source for XAU/USD and CAD/USD, with BTC/USD fallback.

nodes.title: Yahoo Finance
nodes.description: Chart source for SPX500 30-minute candles using ^GSPC by default and ES=F for futures context.

nodes.title: CoinMarketCap Fear & Greed
nodes.description: Crypto sentiment source accessed only through /api/fear-greed.

nodes.title: External Trading Tools
nodes.description: Linked specialist platforms and manual checklist inputs. The MVP summarizes these tools instead of rebuilding them.

nodes.title: @gexbot15 Gamma Image
nodes.description: User-provided gamma chart reference. The app stores the image as a local data URL; it does not scrape, OCR, or upload to a server.

nodes.title: Local CSV Files
nodes.description: Browser file inputs for account equity history and exchange closed-trade ledger imports.

nodes.title: Economic Calendar Fixture
nodes.description: Static 2026 economic events derived from the local Forex Factory spreadsheet workflow and filtered by active date.

nodes.title: Quote Normalizers
nodes.description: Transforms FMP and Twelve Data payloads into the shared MarketQuote contract and controlled error/unavailable rows.

nodes.title: Yahoo Candle Normalizer
nodes.description: Parses Yahoo chart payloads into typed 30-minute market candles.

nodes.title: Fear & Greed Normalizer
nodes.description: Maps CoinMarketCap response data to the dashboard FearGreedSnapshot view model.

nodes.title: CSV Import Parsers
nodes.description: Validates account equity CSV rows and exchange trade ledger CSV rows before persistence and metric derivation.

nodes.title: Performance Calculations
nodes.description: Derives account-equity return snapshots and closed-trade metrics, then adapts domain results into PerformanceSnapshot for the module.

nodes.title: Snapshot Normalizers
nodes.description: Creates, clones, and normalizes DailyDashboardSnapshot, GammaSnapshot, market capture, sentiment capture, and manual market-news shapes.

nodes.title: Economic Calendar Helpers
nodes.description: Normalizes spreadsheet rows, Excel time fractions, and per-day event ordering for the Trading Context calendar column.

nodes.title: Market Quotes Browser Cache
nodes.description: Client-side stale quote cache used when /api/market-quotes fails after a previous successful response.

nodes.title: Fear & Greed Browser Cache
nodes.description: Client-side stale sentiment cache used when /api/fear-greed fails after a previous successful response.

nodes.title: Account Equity Import Store
nodes.description: Browser localStorage for imported account equity history and import summary. Kept separate from daily snapshots and trade ledger records.

nodes.title: Exchange Trade Ledger Store
nodes.description: Browser localStorage for imported exchange closed-trade records and import summary. Kept separate from daily snapshots and account equity history.

nodes.title: Server Memory Caches
nodes.description: Non-durable module-level caches for market quotes and Fear & Greed route results. They reset with the server process or deployment runtime.

nodes.title: Manual Market News Snapshot
nodes.description: Curated daily headlines are manually added, edited, deleted, and saved inside DailyDashboardSnapshot.marketNews.

nodes.title: Supabase Persistence
nodes.description: Referenced as the durable multi-device persistence and auth migration path. No Supabase client, schema, or backend writes are implemented.

nodes.title: Google Sheets Sync
nodes.description: Referenced as a future account-equity history source after the manual CSV workflow is proven. No sync integration is implemented.

nodes.title: XLSX Import
nodes.description: Referenced as future exchange import support. Current import support is CSV only.

nodes.title: Market News Ingestion
nodes.description: Referenced as future watched news/X ingestion. Current Market News is manual curated daily snapshot state only.

nodes.title: Gamma OCR / Provider Automation
nodes.description: Referenced as future work only. Current Gamma workflow is manual-first with local image reference; no scraping, OCR, provider automation, or server upload exists.

nodes.title: Exchange API Integration
nodes.description: Referenced as a limitation/future path. Current exchange trade data enters through local CSV import only.

flows.title: App Composition
flows.summary: The App Router page renders DashboardShell from mock view-model data, and DashboardShell wraps all modules in DailySnapshotProvider.
steps: src/app/page.tsx imports dashboardData.
DashboardShell renders top-bar telemetry and module slots.
DailySnapshotProvider gives modules shared active-date daily state.

flows.title: Daily Snapshot Persistence
flows.summary: DailyDashboardSnapshot is the local command-state center. It is date-keyed, normalized on load, and saved through provider actions.
steps: Provider loads today's snapshot from localStorage after mount.
Missing dates create a draft from the mock daily snapshot template.
Saved dates are inferred from localStorage keys.
saveSnapshot/updateSnapshot persists the full active snapshot.

flows.title: Market Overview Flow
flows.summary: Market Overview renders mock-first, hydrates quotes from the server proxy, stores successful browser stale cache, and renders candles through Yahoo Finance route data.
steps: MarketSituationModule renders fallback watchlist and SPX context.
Client fetches /api/market-quotes after mount.
The route fetches FMP and Twelve Data using server-side keys.
FMP/Twelve payloads normalize to MarketQuote rows.
Successful quote results save to browser stale cache.
MarketOverviewCandlesChart fetches /api/market-candles for Index or Futures.
Yahoo candle payloads normalize and render through lightweight-charts.

flows.title: Explicit Market Snapshot Capture
flows.summary: Live/cache quote and sentiment data remain separate from daily snapshots until the user clicks Capture Market Snapshot.
steps: Market Overview publishes a market capture candidate to DailySnapshotProvider.
Fear & Greed publishes a sentiment capture candidate to DailySnapshotProvider.
Capture Market Snapshot builds SPX and FearGreed snapshot fields from candidates.
The active date's localStorage snapshot is updated with preserved provider/status/source labels.

flows.title: Performance Review / Import Flow
flows.summary: Performance Review supports local account-equity CSV import and exchange trade-ledger CSV import, keeping both stores separate from daily snapshots.
steps: User chooses an account equity or trade ledger CSV through Performance Review actions.
FileReader passes CSV text to the appropriate parser.
Parser result renders import summary and issues.
Confirm Import saves accepted records and import summary to localStorage.
Performance metrics derive from account equity history plus optional accepted closed-trade records.
Manual Current Position saves separately into DailyDashboardSnapshot.currentPosition.

flows.title: Trading Context Save / Cancel Flow
flows.summary: Synthesis Notes and checklist status changes operate on active-date DailyDashboardSnapshot state. Draft edits are reset on cancel or date switch.
steps: Trading Context clones saved synthesis into local draft state.
Edit mode mutates draft fields only.
Save writes updated synthesis and timestamps through DailySnapshotProvider.updateSnapshot.
Cancel restores the draft from the saved snapshot.
Checklist status buttons cycle not checked, watch, checked and immediately save the full snapshot.
Changing active date loads that date and exits edit modes.

flows.title: Economic Calendar Flow
flows.summary: The Economic Calendar column uses a static 2026 event dataset and filters/sorts events for the active date.
steps: Trading Context reads activeDate from DailySnapshotProvider.
getEconomicCalendarEventsForDate filters economicCalendar2026.
Events render in time order inside the Economic Calendar column.

flows.title: Market News Curated Snapshot Flow
flows.summary: Market News is a manual curated read stored in the active daily snapshot. Future watched-source ingestion is planned but not implemented.
steps: User clicks Edit in the Market News column.
Draft headlines can be added, changed, deleted, categorized, and linked.
Save trims and filters headlines, assigns the active date, and persists them through DailySnapshotProvider.
Cancel restores draft headlines from the active saved snapshot.

flows.title: Manual Daily Edit Flows
flows.summary: Manual Current Position, Gamma Context, Gamma Image, Synthesis Notes, Checklist, and Market News save into active-date daily snapshot state.
steps: Manual form edits are staged in component-local draft state.
Save validates or normalizes values and calls updateSnapshot.
Cancel resets drafts from the saved snapshot.
Date switching cancels unsaved drafts and loads the selected date.

flows.title: Fear & Greed Flow
flows.summary: CoinMarketCap sentiment data is fetched through a server-side route, cached, shown in the module, and only persisted to daily history through explicit capture.
steps: FearGreedModule starts from mock prop data.
Client fetches /api/fear-greed after mount.
The route fetches CoinMarketCap with CMC_API_KEY and in-memory stale fallback.
Successful reads save to browser stale cache and publish a capture candidate.
Explicit Capture Market Snapshot persists the current read into DailyDashboardSnapshot.fearGreed.

flows.title: Authentication Gate
flows.summary: A minimal password gate protects app routes through a signed httpOnly cookie.
steps: Proxy allows /login and /api/login.
Unauthenticated protected requests redirect to /login with next path.
POST /api/login compares submitted password with server-side DASHBOARD_PASSWORD.
Successful login sets trading_dashboard_auth as an httpOnly cookie.

flows.title: Future Supabase Migration Path
flows.summary: Docs reference Supabase as the future durable persistence and auth layer. It is not implemented.
steps: Daily snapshots are the likely durable command-state table.
Account equity history remains separate from daily snapshots.
Exchange trade ledger records remain separate from account equity and daily snapshots.
Derived summaries can be stored or recomputed after source records are durable.
Supabase/auth providers are deferred until after the private local MVP.
